All three functions are now implemented and exported:

1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js — limits n to the inclusive range [min, max]
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js — formats byte counts with one decimal place, switching between B/KB/MB/GB as appropriate
3. **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js — converts titles to URL-safe slugs by lowercasing, trimming, replacing spaces with dashes, and removing non-alphanumeric characters (except dashes)
